body.name: CIlambda
body.def: On \(\{\widehat p_H\in\mathfrak D_H\}\), \(CI_{\lambda}=[\lambda^{\mathsf T}F_H(\widehat p_H)-z_{1-\alpha/2}\sqrt{\lambda^{\mathsf T}\widehat\Sigma_H\lambda/n},\ \lambda^{\mathsf T}F_H(\widehat p_H)+z_{1-\alpha/2}\sqrt{\lambda^{\mathsf T}\widehat\Sigma_H\lambda/n}]\); off this event \(CI_{\lambda}\) is not reported.
